modmenu.summaryTranslation.mfr: A reimagined nether fortress that comes intact, damaged or ruined. The more ruin, the tougher the fight and the better the loot.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mfr: Moog's Fortress Reimagined replaces the nether fortress with a huge, detailed fortress that comes intact, damaged or ruined. The more ruined it is, the tougher the fight and the better the loot.
